1.web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
1.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
1.bsb: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,

1.web: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
1.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
1.bsb: just as they were handed down to us by the initial eyewitnesses and servants of the word.

1.web: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
1.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
1.bsb: Therefore, having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,

1.web: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
1.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
1.bsb: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

1.web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
1.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
1.bsb: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah, and whose wife Elizabeth was a daughter of Aaron.

1.web: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
1.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
1.bsb: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.

1.web: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
1.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
1.bsb: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well along in years.

1.web: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division,
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,
1.bsb: One day while Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,

1.web: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
1.kjv: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
1.bsb: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

1.web: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
1.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
1.bsb: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.

1.web: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
1.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
1.bsb: Just then an angel of the Lord appeared to Zechariah, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

1.web: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
1.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
1.bsb: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and gripped with fear.

1.web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
1.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
1.bsb: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.

1.web: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.
1.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
1.bsb: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,

1.web: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
1.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.
1.bsb: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.

1.web: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.
1.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
1.bsb: Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God.

1.web: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
1.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
1.bsb: And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”

1.web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
1.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
1.bsb: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”

1.web: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.
1.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
1.bsb: “I am Gabriel,” replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

1.web: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
1.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
1.bsb: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”

1.web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
1.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
1.bsb: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.

1.web: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
1.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
1.bsb: When he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them but remained speechless.

1.web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
1.bsb: And when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.

1.web: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
1.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
1.bsb: After these days, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. She declared,

1.web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
1.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men.
1.bsb: “The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”

1.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
1.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
1.bsb: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,

1.web: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
1.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
1.bsb: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, who was of the house of David. And the virgin’s name was Mary.

1.web: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
1.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
1.bsb: The angel appeared to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.”

1.web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
1.kjv: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
1.bsb: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.

1.web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
1.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
1.bsb: So the angel told her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

1.web: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and give birth to a son, and will call his name ‘Jesus.’
1.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
1.bsb: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.

1.web: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,
1.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
1.bsb: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,

1.web: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
1.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
1.bsb: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!”

1.web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
1.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
1.bsb: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”

1.web: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
1.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
1.bsb: The angel replied, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.

1.web: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
1.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
1.bsb: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.

1.web: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
1.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
1.bsb: For no word from God will ever fail.”

1.web: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.
1.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
1.bsb: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May it happen to me according to your word.” Then the angel left her.

1.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
1.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
1.bsb: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,

1.web: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
1.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
1.bsb: where she entered the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.

1.web: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
1.bsb: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

1.web: She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
1.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
1.bsb: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

1.web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
1.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
1.bsb: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

1.web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
1.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
1.bsb: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

1.web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
1.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
1.bsb: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.”

1.web: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
1.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
1.bsb: Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord,

1.web: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
1.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
1.bsb: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!

1.web: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
1.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
1.bsb: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.

1.web: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
1.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
1.bsb: For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.

1.web: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
1.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
1.bsb: His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.

1.web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
1.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
1.bsb: He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.

1.web: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.
1.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
1.bsb: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.

1.web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
1.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
1.bsb: He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.

1.web: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
1.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
1.bsb: He has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,

1.web: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
1.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
1.bsb: as He promised to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants forever.”

1.web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
1.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
1.bsb: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home.

1.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
1.kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
1.bsb: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.

1.web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.
1.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
1.bsb: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.

1.web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
1.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
1.bsb: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.

1.web: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
1.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so ; but he shall be called John.
1.bsb: But his mother replied, “No! He shall be called John.”

1.web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
1.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
1.bsb: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”

1.web: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
1.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
1.bsb: So they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.

1.web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
1.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
1.bsb: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.

1.web: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
1.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed , and he spake, and praised God.
1.bsb: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.

1.web: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
1.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.
1.bsb: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of Judea were talking about these events.

1.web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
1.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
1.bsb: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him.

1.web: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
1.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
1.bsb: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:

1.web: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
1.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
1.bsb: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.

1.web: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
1.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
1.bsb: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,

1.web: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
1.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
1.bsb: as He spoke through His holy prophets, those of ages past,

1.web: salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all who hate us;
1.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
1.bsb: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,

1.web: to show mercy towards our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
1.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
1.bsb: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,

1.web: the oath which he swore to Abraham, our father,
1.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
1.bsb: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us

1.web: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
1.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
1.bsb: deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,

1.web: In holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
1.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
1.bsb: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.

1.web: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
1.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
1.bsb: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him,

1.web: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
1.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
1.bsb: to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

1.web: because of the tender mercy of our God, whereby the dawn from on high will visit us,
1.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
1.bsb: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the Dawn will visit us from on high,

1.web: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
1.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
1.bsb: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.”

1.web: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
1.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
1.bsb: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel.

2.web: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
2.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
2.bsb: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.

2.web: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
2.kjv: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
2.bsb: This was the first census to take place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.

2.web: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
2.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
2.bsb: And everyone went to his own town to register.

2.web: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;
2.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
2.bsb: So Joseph also went up from Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, since he was from the house and line of David.

2.web: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
2.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
2.bsb: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.

2.web: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
2.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
2.bsb: While they were there, the time came for her Child to be born.

2.web: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
2.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
2.bsb: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.

2.web: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
2.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
2.bsb: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.

2.web: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
2.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
2.bsb: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

2.web: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
2.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
2.bsb: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:

2.web: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
2.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
2.bsb: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!

2.web: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
2.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
2.bsb: And this will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”

2.web: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
2.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
2.bsb: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:

2.web: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
2.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
2.bsb: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”

2.web: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
2.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
2.bsb: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

2.web: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
2.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
2.bsb: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.

2.web: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
2.kjv: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
2.bsb: After they had seen the Child, they spread the message they had received about Him.

2.web: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
2.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
2.bsb: And all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.

2.web: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
2.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
2.bsb: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

2.web: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
2.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
2.bsb: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, which was just as the angel had told them.

2.web: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
2.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
2.bsb: When the eight days until His circumcision had passed, He was named Jesus, the name the angel had given Him before He had been conceived.

2.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord
2.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
2.bsb: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord

2.web: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
2.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
2.bsb: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “Every firstborn male shall be consecrated to the Lord”),

2.web: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
2.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
2.bsb: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.”

2.web: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
2.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
2.bsb: Now there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

2.web: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
2.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
2.bsb: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

2.web: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
2.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
2.bsb: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law,

2.web: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
2.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
2.bsb: Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God, saying:

2.web: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
2.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
2.bsb: “Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace.

2.web: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
2.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
2.bsb: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,

2.web: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
2.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
2.bsb: which You have prepared in the sight of all people,

2.web: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
2.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
2.bsb: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”

2.web: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,
2.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
2.bsb: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.

2.web: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
2.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
2.bsb: Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary: “Behold, this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,

2.web: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
2.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
2.bsb: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed—and a sword will pierce your soul as well.”

2.web: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
2.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
2.bsb: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,

2.web: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
2.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
2.bsb: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

2.web: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
2.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
2.bsb: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.

2.web: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
2.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
2.bsb: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.

2.web: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
2.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
2.bsb: And the Child grew and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.

2.web: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
2.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
2.bsb: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.

2.web: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,
2.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
2.bsb: And when He was twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the Feast.

2.web: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
2.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .
2.bsb: When those days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware He had stayed.

2.web: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
2.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
2.bsb: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.

2.web: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
2.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
2.bsb: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.

2.web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.
2.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
2.bsb: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

2.web: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
2.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
2.bsb: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.

2.web: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
2.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
2.bsb: When His parents saw Him, they were astonished. “Child, why have You done this to us?” His mother asked. “Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.”

2.web: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
2.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?
2.bsb: “Why were you looking for Me?” He asked. “Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house?”

2.web: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
2.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
2.bsb: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them.

2.web: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
2.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
2.bsb: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.

2.web: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
2.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
2.bsb: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

3.web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
3.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
3.bsb: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

3.web: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
3.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
3.bsb: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.

3.web: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
3.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
3.bsb: He went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,

3.web: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
3.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
3.bsb: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.

3.web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
3.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
3.bsb: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. The crooked ways shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.

3.web: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
3.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
3.bsb: And all humanity will see God’s salvation.’”

3.web: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
3.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
3.bsb: Then John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

3.web: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
3.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
3.bsb: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

3.web: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.”
3.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
3.bsb: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”

3.web: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
3.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
3.bsb: The crowds asked him, “What then should we do?”

3.web: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
3.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
3.bsb: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”

3.web: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
3.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
3.bsb: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”

3.web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
3.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
3.bsb: “Collect no more than you are authorized,” he answered.

3.web: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
3.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
3.bsb: Then some soldiers asked him, “And what should we do?” “Do not take money by force or false accusation,” he said. “Be content with your wages.”

3.web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
3.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
3.bsb: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.

3.web: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
3.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
3.bsb: John answered all of them: “I baptize you with water, but One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

3.web: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
3.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
3.bsb: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

3.web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
3.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
3.bsb: With these and many other exhortations, John proclaimed the good news to the people.

3.web: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
3.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
3.bsb: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,

3.web: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
3.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
3.bsb: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

3.web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,
3.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
3.bsb: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as He was praying, heaven was opened,

3.web: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
3.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
3.bsb: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”

3.bsb: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

3.web: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
3.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
3.bsb: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan,

3.web: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
3.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
3.bsb: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

4.web: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
4.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
4.bsb: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

4.web: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
4.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
4.bsb: where for forty days He was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and when they had ended, He was hungry.

4.web: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
4.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
4.bsb: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”

4.web: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
4.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
4.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’”

4.web: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
4.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
4.bsb: Then the devil led Him up to a high place and showed Him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.

4.web: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.
4.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
4.bsb: “I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,” he said. “For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.

4.web: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
4.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
4.bsb: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”

4.web: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
4.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
4.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”

4.web: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
4.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
4.bsb: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.

4.web: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
4.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
4.bsb: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully;

4.web: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
4.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
4.bsb: and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”

4.web: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
4.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
4.bsb: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”

4.web: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
4.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
4.bsb: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.

4.web: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
4.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
4.bsb: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news about Him spread throughout the surrounding region.

4.web: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
4.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
4.bsb: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone.

4.web: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
4.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
4.bsb: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read,

4.web: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
4.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
4.bsb: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:

4.web: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
4.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
4.bsb: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed,

4.web: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
4.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
4.bsb: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”

4.web: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
4.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
4.bsb: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him,

4.web: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
4.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
4.bsb: and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”

4.web: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
4.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?
4.bsb: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph?” they asked.

4.web: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this parable, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
4.bsb: Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum.’”

4.web: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
4.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
4.bsb: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

4.web: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
4.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
4.bsb: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.

4.web: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
4.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
4.bsb: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.

4.web: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
4.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
4.bsb: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”

4.web: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
4.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
4.bsb: On hearing this, all the people in the synagogue were enraged.

4.web: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
4.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
4.bsb: They got up, drove Him out of the town, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw Him over the cliff.

4.web: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
4.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
4.bsb: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way.

4.web: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
4.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
4.bsb: Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people.

4.web: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
4.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
4.bsb: They were astonished at His teaching, because His message had authority.

4.web: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
4.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
4.bsb: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,

4.web: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
4.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
4.bsb: “Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”

4.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
4.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
4.bsb: But Jesus rebuked the demon. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!” At this, the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without harming him.

4.web: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
4.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
4.bsb: All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

4.web: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
4.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
4.bsb: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region.

4.web: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.
4.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
4.bsb: After Jesus had left the synagogue, He went to the home of Simon, whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever. So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf,

4.web: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
4.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
4.bsb: and He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and began to serve them.

4.web: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
4.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
4.bsb: At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Jesus, and laying His hands on each one, He healed them.

4.web: Demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
4.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
4.bsb: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ.

4.web: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
4.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
4.bsb: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place, and the crowds were looking for Him. They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving.

4.web: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
4.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
4.bsb: But Jesus told them, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.”

4.web: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
4.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
4.bsb: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.

5.web: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
5.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
5.bsb: On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,

5.web: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
5.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
5.bsb: He saw two boats at the edge of the lake. The fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.

5.web: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
5.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
5.bsb: Jesus got into the boat belonging to Simon and asked him to put out a little from shore. And sitting down, He taught the people from the boat.

5.web: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.”
5.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
5.bsb: When Jesus had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”

5.web: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
5.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
5.bsb: “Master,” Simon replied, “we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.”

5.web: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
5.kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
5.bsb: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to tear.

5.web: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
5.kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
5.bsb: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

5.web: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
5.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
5.bsb: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”

5.web: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
5.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
5.bsb: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

5.web: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
5.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
5.bsb: and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee. “Do not be afraid,” Jesus said to Simon. “From now on you will catch men.”

5.web: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
5.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
5.bsb: And when they had brought their boats ashore, they left everything and followed Him.

5.web: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
5.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
5.bsb: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell facedown and begged Him, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”

5.web: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
5.kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
5.bsb: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.

5.web: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
5.kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
5.bsb: “Do not tell anyone,” Jesus instructed him. “But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”

5.web: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
5.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
5.bsb: But the news about Jesus spread all the more, and great crowds came to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

5.web: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.
5.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
5.bsb: Yet He frequently withdrew to the wilderness to pray.

5.web: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
5.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
5.bsb: One day Jesus was teaching, and the Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. People had come from Jerusalem and from every village of Galilee and Judea, and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal the sick.

5.web: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
5.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
5.bsb: Just then some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They tried to bring him inside to set him before Jesus,

5.web: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
5.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
5.bsb: but they could not find a way through the crowd. So they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.

5.web: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
5.kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
5.bsb: When Jesus saw their faith, He said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”

5.web: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
5.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
5.bsb: But the scribes and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

5.web: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
5.kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
5.bsb: Knowing what they were thinking, Jesus replied, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?

5.web: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you;’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk?’
5.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
5.bsb: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’

5.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins” (he said to the paralyzed man), “I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house.”
5.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
5.bsb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic, “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”

5.web: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
5.kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
5.bsb: And immediately the man stood up before them, took what he had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.

5.web: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
5.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
