9.bsb: Suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, “Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.

9.web: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
9.kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
9.bsb: A spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him.

9.web: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
9.kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
9.bsb: I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”

9.web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
9.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
9.bsb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”

9.web: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
9.kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
9.bsb: Even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

9.web: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
9.kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
9.bsb: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing, He said to His disciples,

9.web: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
9.kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
9.bsb: “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.”

9.web: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
9.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
9.bsb: But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.

9.web: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.
9.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
9.bsb: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.

9.web: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,
9.kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
9.bsb: But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.

9.web: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”
9.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
9.bsb: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.”

9.web: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
9.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
9.bsb: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”

9.web: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
9.bsb: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied, “for whoever is not against you is for you.”

9.web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,
9.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
9.bsb: As the day of His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

9.web: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
9.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
9.bsb: He sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.

9.web: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.
9.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
9.bsb: But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.

9.web: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
9.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this , they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
9.bsb: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?”

9.web: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
9.kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
9.bsb: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.

9.web: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.
9.kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them . And they went to another village.
9.bsb: And He and His disciples went on to another village.

9.web: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
9.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
9.bsb: As they were walking along the road, someone said to Jesus, “I will follow You wherever You go.”

9.web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
9.bsb: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”

9.web: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
9.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
9.bsb: Then He said to another man, “Follow Me.” The man replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

9.web: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”
9.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
9.bsb: But Jesus told him, “Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”

9.web: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
9.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
9.bsb: Still another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.”

9.web: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
9.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
9.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”

10.web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.
10.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
10.bsb: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him to every town and place He was about to visit.

10.web: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
10.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
10.bsb: And He told them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.

10.web: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
10.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
10.bsb: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.

10.web: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
10.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
10.bsb: Carry no purse or bag or sandals. Do not greet anyone along the road.

10.web: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
10.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
10.bsb: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’

10.web: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
10.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
10.bsb: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.

10.web: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
10.kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
10.bsb: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered. For the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move around from house to house.

10.web: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
10.kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
10.bsb: If you enter a town and they welcome you, eat whatever is set before you.

10.web: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
10.kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
10.bsb: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God is near you.’

10.web: But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
10.kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
10.bsb: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,

10.web: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’
10.kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
10.bsb: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.’

10.web: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
10.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
10.bsb: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.

10.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
10.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
10.bsb: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

10.web: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
10.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
10.bsb: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.

10.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
10.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
10.bsb: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades!

10.web: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
10.kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
10.bsb: Whoever listens to you listens to Me; whoever rejects you rejects Me; and whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.”

10.web: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
10.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
10.bsb: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.”

10.web: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
10.kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
10.bsb: So He told them, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

10.web: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
10.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
10.bsb: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.

10.web: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
10.kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
10.bsb: Nevertheless, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

10.web: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
10.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
10.bsb: At that time Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.

10.web: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
10.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
10.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”

10.web: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
10.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
10.bsb: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.

10.web: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
10.kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
10.bsb: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.”

10.web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
10.kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
10.bsb: One day an expert in the law stood up to test Him. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

10.web: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
10.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
10.bsb: “What is written in the Law?” Jesus replied. “How do you read it?”

10.web: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
10.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
10.bsb: He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’”

10.web: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
10.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
10.bsb: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus said. “Do this and you will live.”

10.web: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
10.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
10.bsb: But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”

10.web: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
10.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him , and departed, leaving him half dead.
10.bsb: Jesus took up this question and said, “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.

10.web: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
10.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
10.bsb: Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

10.web: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
10.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side.
10.bsb: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.

10.web: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
10.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him ,
10.bsb: But when a Samaritan on a journey came upon him, he looked at him and had compassion.

10.web: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
10.kjv: And went to him , and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
10.bsb: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

10.web: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
10.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
10.bsb: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Take care of him,’ he said, ‘and on my return I will repay you for any additional expense.’

10.web: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
10.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
10.bsb: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”

10.web: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
10.kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
10.bsb: “The one who showed him mercy,” replied the expert in the law. Then Jesus told him, “Go and do likewise.”

10.web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
10.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
10.bsb: As they traveled along, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.

10.web: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
10.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
10.bsb: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message.

10.web: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
10.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
10.bsb: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations to be made. She came to Jesus and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!”

10.web: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
10.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
10.bsb: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord replied, “you are worried and upset about many things.

10.web: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
10.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
10.bsb: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.”

11.web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
11.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
11.bsb: One day in a place where Jesus had just finished praying, one of His disciples requested, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.”

11.web: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
11.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
11.bsb: So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.

11.web: Give us day by day our daily bread.
11.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
11.bsb: Give us each day our daily bread.

11.web: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
11.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
11.bsb: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation.’”

11.web: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
11.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
11.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Suppose one of you goes to his friend at midnight and says, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

11.web: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
11.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
11.bsb: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’

11.web: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
11.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
11.bsb: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’

11.web: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
11.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
11.bsb: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.

11.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
11.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
11.bsb: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

11.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
11.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
11.bsb: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

11.web: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
11.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
11.bsb: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

11.web: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
11.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
11.bsb: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

11.web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
11.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
11.bsb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”

11.web: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
11.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
11.bsb: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,

11.web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
11.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
11.bsb: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”

11.web: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
11.kjv: And others, tempting him , sought of him a sign from heaven.
11.bsb: And others tested Him by demanding a sign from heaven.

11.web: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
11.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
11.bsb: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.

11.web: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
11.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
11.bsb: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.

11.web: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.
11.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
11.bsb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

11.web: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.
11.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
11.bsb: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

11.web: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
11.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
11.bsb: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.

11.web: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
11.kjv: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
11.bsb: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted, and then he divides up his plunder.

11.web: “He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
11.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
11.bsb: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

11.web: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
11.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
11.bsb: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’

11.web: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
11.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
11.bsb: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.

11.web: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
11.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
11.bsb: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first.”

11.web: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
11.kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
11.bsb: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said, “Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!”

11.web: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
11.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
11.bsb: But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”

11.web: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.
11.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
11.bsb: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.

11.web: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.
11.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
11.bsb: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.

11.web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
11.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
11.bsb: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.

11.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
11.kjv: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
11.bsb: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.

11.web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
11.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
11.bsb: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.

11.web: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
11.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
11.bsb: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.

11.web: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
11.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
11.bsb: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.

11.web: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
11.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
11.bsb: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”

11.web: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.
11.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
11.bsb: As Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee invited Him to dine with him; so He went in and reclined at the table.

11.web: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
11.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
11.bsb: But the Pharisee was surprised to see that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.

11.web: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
11.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
11.bsb: “Now then,” said the Lord, “you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.

11.web: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
11.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
11.bsb: You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?

11.web: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
11.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
11.bsb: But give as alms the things that are within you, and you will see that everything is clean for you.

11.web: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
11.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
11.bsb: Woe to you Pharisees! You pay tithes of mint, rue, and every herb, but you disregard justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former.

11.web: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.
11.kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
11.bsb: Woe to you Pharisees! You love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

11.web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
11.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
11.bsb: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.”

11.web: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
11.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
11.bsb: One of the experts in the law told Him, “Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us as well.”

11.web: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
11.kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
11.bsb: “Woe to you as well, experts in the law!” He replied. “You weigh men down with heavy burdens, but you yourselves will not lift a finger to lighten their load.

11.web: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
11.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
11.bsb: Woe to you! You build tombs for the prophets, but it was your fathers who killed them.

11.web: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
11.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
11.bsb: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.

11.web: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
11.kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
11.bsb: Because of this, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’

11.web: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
11.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
11.bsb: As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,

11.web: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
11.kjv: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
11.bsb: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation.

11.web: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
11.kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
11.bsb: Woe to you experts in the law! For you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”

11.web: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;
11.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
11.bsb: As Jesus went on from there, the scribes and Pharisees began to oppose Him bitterly and to ply Him with questions about many things,

11.web: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
11.kjv: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
11.bsb: waiting to catch Him in something He might say.

12.web: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
12.kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
12.bsb: In the meantime, a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling one another. Jesus began to speak first to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

12.web: But there is nothing covered up, that will not be revealed, nor hidden, that will not be known.
12.kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
12.bsb: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.

12.web: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
12.kjv: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
12.bsb: What you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops.

12.web: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
12.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
12.bsb: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.

12.web: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him, who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
12.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
12.bsb: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!

12.web: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
12.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
12.bsb: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.

12.web: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
12.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
12.bsb: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

12.web: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, him will the Son of Man also confess before the angels of God;
12.kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
12.bsb: I tell you, everyone who confesses Me before men, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God.

12.web: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of the angels of God.
12.kjv: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
12.bsb: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.

12.web: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
12.kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
12.bsb: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

12.web: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer, or what you will say;
12.kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
12.bsb: When you are brought before synagogues, rulers, and authorities, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or what to say.

12.web: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
12.kjv: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
12.bsb: For at that time the Holy Spirit will teach you what you should say.”

12.web: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
12.kjv: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
12.bsb: Someone in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

12.web: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”
12.kjv: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
12.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed Me judge or executor between you?”

12.web: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
12.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
12.bsb: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”

12.web: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
12.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
12.bsb: Then He told them a parable: “The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance.

12.web: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
12.kjv: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
12.bsb: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’

12.web: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
12.kjv: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
12.bsb: Then he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones, and there I will store up all my grain and my goods.

12.web: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, be merry.”’
12.kjv: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
12.bsb: Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’

12.web: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’
12.kjv: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
12.bsb: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?’

12.web: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
12.kjv: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
12.bsb: This is how it will be for anyone who stores up treasure for himself but is not rich toward God.”

12.web: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.
12.kjv: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
12.bsb: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.

12.web: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
12.kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
12.bsb: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.

12.web: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!
12.kjv: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
12.bsb: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!

12.web: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
12.kjv: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
12.bsb: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

12.web: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?
12.kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
12.bsb: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?

12.web: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
12.kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
12.bsb: Consider how the lilies grow: They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.

12.web: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
12.kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
12.bsb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!

12.web: Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
12.kjv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
12.bsb: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink. Do not worry about it.

12.web: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
12.kjv: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
12.bsb: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.

12.web: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.
12.kjv: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
12.bsb: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be added unto you.

12.web: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
12.kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
12.bsb: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.

12.web: Sell that which you have, and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches, neither moth destroys.
12.kjv: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
12.bsb: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

12.web: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
12.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
12.bsb: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

12.web: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.
12.kjv: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
12.bsb: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.

12.web: Be like men watching for their lord, when he returns from the marriage feast; that, when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
12.kjv: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
12.bsb: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.

12.web: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you, that he will dress himself, and make them recline, and will come and serve them.
12.kjv: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
12.bsb: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.

12.web: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch, and finds them so.
12.kjv: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
12.bsb: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.

12.web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not allowed his house to be broken into.
12.kjv: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
12.bsb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.

12.web: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
12.kjv: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
12.bsb: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.”

12.web: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”
12.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
12.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”

12.web: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?
12.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
12.bsb: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?

12.web: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
12.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
12.bsb: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

12.web: Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.
12.kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
12.bsb: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

12.web: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken,
12.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
12.bsb: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.

12.web: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
12.kjv: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
12.bsb: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.

12.web: That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
12.kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself , neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes .
12.bsb: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.

12.web: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
12.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes . For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
12.bsb: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.

12.web: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
12.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
12.bsb: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

12.web: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
12.kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
12.bsb: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

12.web: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
12.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
12.bsb: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.

12.web: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
12.kjv: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
12.bsb: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.

12.web: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
12.kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
12.bsb: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”

12.web: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
12.kjv: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
12.bsb: Then Jesus said to the crowds, “As soon as you see a cloud rising in the west, you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and that is what happens.

12.web: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
12.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
12.bsb: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.

12.web: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
12.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
12.bsb: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. Why don’t you know how to interpret the present time?

12.web: Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
12.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
12.bsb: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

12.web: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
12.kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
12.bsb: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. Otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.

12.web: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.”
12.kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
12.bsb: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.”

13.web: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
13.kjv: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
13.bsb: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

13.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
13.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?
13.bsb: To this He replied, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this fate?

13.web: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
13.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
13.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

13.web: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
13.kjv: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
13.bsb: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them: Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem?

13.web: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
13.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
13.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”

13.web: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.
13.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
13.bsb: Then Jesus told this parable: “A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.

13.web: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?’
13.kjv: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
13.bsb: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘Look, for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Therefore cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’

13.web: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.
13.kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it :
13.bsb: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

13.web: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
13.kjv: And if it bear fruit, well : and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
13.bsb: If it bears fruit next year, fine. But if not, you can cut it down.’”

13.web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
13.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
13.bsb: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,

13.web: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
13.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself .
13.bsb: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.

13.web: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
13.kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him , and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
13.bsb: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your disability.”

13.web: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.
13.kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
13.bsb: Then He placed His hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify God.

13.web: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
13.kjv: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
13.bsb: But the synagogue leader was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath. “There are six days for work,” he told the crowd. “So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.”

13.web: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?
13.kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
13.bsb: “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied. “Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?

13.web: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
13.kjv: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
13.bsb: Then should not this daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day?”

13.web: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
13.kjv: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
13.bsb: When Jesus said this, all His adversaries were humiliated. And the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things He was doing.

13.web: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
13.kjv: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
13.bsb: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?

13.web: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”
13.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
13.bsb: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.”

13.web: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
13.kjv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
13.bsb: Again He asked, “To what can I compare the kingdom of God?

13.web: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
13.kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
13.bsb: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”

13.web: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
13.kjv: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
13.bsb: Then Jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages, teaching as He made His way toward Jerusalem.

13.web: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
13.kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
13.bsb: “Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?” Jesus answered,

13.web: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.
13.kjv: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
13.bsb: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.

13.web: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
13.kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
13.bsb: After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’

13.web: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
13.kjv: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
13.bsb: Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’

13.web: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
13.kjv: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
13.bsb: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.’

13.web: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets, in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.
13.kjv: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
13.bsb: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.

13.web: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
13.kjv: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
13.bsb: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.

13.web: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
13.kjv: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
