13.bsb: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.”

13.web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
13.kjv: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
13.bsb: At that very hour, some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him, “Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.”

13.web: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
13.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
13.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach My goal.’

13.web: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’
13.kjv: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
13.bsb: Nevertheless, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.

13.web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
13.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
13.bsb: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!

13.web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
13.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
13.bsb: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”

14.web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
14.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
14.bsb: One Sabbath, Jesus went to eat in the home of a leading Pharisee, and those in attendance were watching Him closely.

14.web: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
14.kjv: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
14.bsb: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy.

14.web: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
14.kjv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
14.bsb: So Jesus asked the experts in the law and the Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”

14.web: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
14.kjv: And they held their peace. And he took him , and healed him, and let him go;
14.bsb: But they remained silent. Then Jesus took hold of the man, healed him, and sent him on his way.

14.web: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
14.kjv: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
14.bsb: And He asked them, “Which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the Sabbath day will not immediately pull him out?”

14.web: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
14.kjv: And they could not answer him again to these things.
14.bsb: And they were unable to answer these questions.

14.web: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
14.kjv: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
14.bsb: When Jesus noticed how the guests chose the places of honor, He told them a parable:

14.web: “When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
14.kjv: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
14.bsb: “When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.

14.web: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
14.kjv: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
14.bsb: Then the host who invited both of you will come and tell you, ‘Give this man your seat.’ And in humiliation, you will have to take the last place.

14.web: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
14.kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
14.bsb: But when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.

14.web: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
14.kjv: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
14.bsb: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”

14.web: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
14.kjv: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
14.bsb: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited Him, “When you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. Otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.

14.web: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
14.kjv: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
14.bsb: But when you host a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind,

14.web: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
14.kjv: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
14.bsb: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”

14.web: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”
14.kjv: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
14.bsb: When one of those reclining with Him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.”

14.web: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
14.kjv: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
14.bsb: But Jesus replied, “A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.

14.web: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
14.kjv: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
14.bsb: When it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’

14.web: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
14.kjv: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
14.bsb: But one after another they all began to make excuses. The first one said, ‘I have bought a field, and I need to go see it. Please excuse me.’

14.web: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
14.kjv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
14.bsb: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’

14.web: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
14.kjv: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
14.bsb: Still another said, ‘I have married a wife, so I cannot come.’

14.web: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
14.kjv: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
14.bsb: The servant returned and reported all this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’

14.web: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
14.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
14.bsb: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’

14.web: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
14.kjv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
14.bsb: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.

14.web: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.’”
14.kjv: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
14.bsb: For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet.’”

14.web: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
14.kjv: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
14.bsb: Large crowds were now traveling with Jesus, and He turned and said to them,

14.web: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
14.kjv: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
14.bsb: “If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.

14.web: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
14.kjv: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
14.bsb: And whoever does not carry his cross and follow Me cannot be My disciple.

14.web: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
14.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it ?
14.bsb: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?

14.web: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
14.kjv: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it , all that behold it begin to mock him,
14.bsb: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,

14.web: saying, ‘This man began to build, and wasn’t able to finish.’
14.kjv: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
14.bsb: saying, ‘This man could not finish what he started to build.’

14.web: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
14.kjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
14.bsb: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?

14.web: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.
14.kjv: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
14.bsb: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.

14.web: So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
14.kjv: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
14.bsb: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple.

14.web: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
14.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
14.bsb: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?

14.web: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
14.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
14.bsb: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

15.web: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
15.kjv: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
15.bsb: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to Jesus.

15.web: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
15.kjv: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
15.bsb: So the Pharisees and scribes began to grumble: “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”

15.web: He told them this parable.
15.kjv: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
15.bsb: Then Jesus told them this parable:

15.web: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
15.kjv: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
15.bsb: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?

15.web: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
15.kjv: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
15.bsb: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,

15.web: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
15.kjv: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
15.bsb: comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’

15.web: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
15.kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
15.bsb: In the same way, I tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.

15.web: Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?
15.kjv: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it ?
15.bsb: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?

15.web: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.’
15.kjv: And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
15.bsb: And when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.’

15.web: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
15.kjv: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
15.bsb: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.”

15.web: He said, “A certain man had two sons.
15.kjv: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
15.bsb: Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.

15.web: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between them.
15.kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me . And he divided unto them his living.
15.bsb: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.

15.web: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
15.kjv: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
15.bsb: After a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.

15.web: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
15.kjv: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
15.bsb: After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.

15.web: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
15.kjv: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
15.bsb: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.

15.web: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
15.kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
15.bsb: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.

15.web: But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
15.kjv: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
15.bsb: Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food? But here I am, starving to death!

15.web: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
15.kjv: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
15.bsb: I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

15.web: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
15.kjv: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
15.bsb: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’

15.web: “He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
15.kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
15.bsb: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.

15.web: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
15.kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
15.bsb: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

15.web: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.
15.kjv: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
15.bsb: But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.

15.web: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;
15.kjv: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it ; and let us eat, and be merry:
15.bsb: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.

15.web: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’ They began to celebrate.
15.kjv: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
15.bsb: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.

15.web: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
15.kjv: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
15.bsb: Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.

15.web: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
15.kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
15.bsb: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.

15.web: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
15.kjv: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
15.bsb: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound.’

15.web: But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.
15.kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
15.bsb: The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.

15.web: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
15.kjv: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
15.bsb: But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

15.web: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
15.kjv: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
15.bsb: But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’

15.web: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
15.kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
15.bsb: ‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.

15.web: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
15.kjv: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
15.bsb: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’”

16.web: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
16.kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
16.bsb: Jesus also said to His disciples, “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.

16.web: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
16.kjv: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
16.bsb: So he called him in to ask, ‘What is this I hear about you? Turn in an account of your management, for you cannot be manager any longer.’

16.web: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
16.kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
16.bsb: The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my position? I am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.

16.web: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
16.kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
16.bsb: I know what I will do, so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’

16.web: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
16.kjv: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors unto him , and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
16.bsb: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.

16.web: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
16.kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
16.bsb: ‘A hundred measures of olive oil,’ he answered. ‘Take your bill,’ said the manager. ‘Sit down quickly, and write fifty.’

16.web: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
16.kjv: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
16.bsb: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ ‘A hundred measures of wheat,’ he replied. ‘Take your bill and write eighty,’ he told him.

16.web: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
16.kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
16.bsb: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.

16.web: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
16.kjv: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
16.bsb: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal dwellings.

16.web: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
16.kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
16.bsb: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

16.web: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
16.kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches ?
16.bsb: So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?

16.web: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
16.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?
16.bsb: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?

16.web: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
16.kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
16.bsb: No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”

16.web: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
16.kjv: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
16.bsb: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all of this and were scoffing at Jesus.

16.web: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
16.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
16.bsb: So He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is prized among men is detestable before God.

16.web: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
16.kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
16.bsb: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

16.web: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
16.kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
16.bsb: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.

16.web: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
16.kjv: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
16.bsb: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

16.web: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
16.kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
16.bsb: Now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.

16.web: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
16.kjv: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
16.bsb: And a beggar named Lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores

16.web: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
16.kjv: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
16.bsb: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.

16.web: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.
16.kjv: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
16.bsb: One day the beggar died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. And the rich man also died and was buried.

16.web: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
16.kjv: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
16.bsb: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham from afar, with Lazarus by his side.

16.web: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
16.kjv: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
16.bsb: So he cried out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. For I am in agony in this fire.’

16.web: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted, and you are in anguish.
16.kjv: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
16.bsb: But Abraham answered, ‘Child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.

16.web: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
16.kjv: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
16.bsb: And besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that even those who wish cannot cross from here to you, nor can anyone cross from there to us.’

16.web: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house;
16.kjv: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house:
16.bsb: ‘Then I beg you, father,’ he said, ‘send Lazarus to my father’s house,

16.web: for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
16.kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
16.bsb: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’

16.web: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
16.kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
16.bsb: But Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the prophets; let your brothers listen to them.’

16.web: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
16.kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
16.bsb: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’

16.web: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
16.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
16.bsb: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”

17.web: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
17.kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him , through whom they come!
17.bsb: Jesus said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!

17.web: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
17.kjv: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
17.bsb: It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.

17.web: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
17.kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
17.bsb: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.

17.web: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
17.kjv: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
17.bsb: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.”

17.web: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
17.kjv: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
17.bsb: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”

17.web: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
17.kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
17.bsb: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.

17.web: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table,’
17.kjv: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
17.bsb: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?

17.web: and will not rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me, while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
17.kjv: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
17.bsb: Instead, won’t he tell him, ‘Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink’?

17.web: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
17.kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
17.bsb: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?

17.web: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
17.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
17.bsb: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’”

17.web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
17.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
17.bsb: While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.

17.web: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
17.kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
17.bsb: As He entered one of the villages, He was met by ten lepers. They stood at a distance

17.web: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
17.kjv: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
17.bsb: and raised their voices, shouting, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

17.web: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
17.kjv: And when he saw them , he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
17.bsb: When Jesus saw them, He said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they were on their way, they were cleansed.

17.web: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
17.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
17.bsb: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.

17.web: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
17.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
17.bsb: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.

17.web: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
17.kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
17.bsb: “Were not all ten cleansed?” Jesus asked. “Where then are the other nine?

17.web: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this stranger?”
17.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
17.bsb: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”

17.web: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
17.kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
17.bsb: Then Jesus said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well!”

17.web: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;
17.kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
17.bsb: When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.

17.web: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
17.kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
17.bsb: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst.”

17.web: He said to the disciples, “The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
17.kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it .
17.bsb: Then He said to the disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

17.web: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away, nor follow after them,
17.kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them , nor follow them .
17.bsb: People will tell you, ‘Look, there He is!’ or ‘Look, here He is!’ Do not go out or chase after them.

17.web: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.
17.kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
17.bsb: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.

17.web: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
17.kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
17.bsb: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

17.web: As it was in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.
17.kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
17.bsb: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:

17.web: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
17.kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
17.bsb: People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.

17.web: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
17.kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
17.bsb: It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

17.web: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky, and destroyed them all.
17.kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
17.bsb: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

17.web: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
17.kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
17.bsb: It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

17.web: In that day, he who will be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
17.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
17.bsb: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.

17.web: Remember Lot’s wife!
17.kjv: Remember Lot’s wife.
17.bsb: Remember Lot’s wife!

17.web: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
17.kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
17.bsb: Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.

17.web: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.
17.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
17.bsb: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: One will be taken and the other left.

17.web: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left.”
17.kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
17.bsb: Two women will be grinding grain together: One will be taken and the other left.”

17.kjv: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

17.web: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together.”
17.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together.
17.bsb: “Where, Lord?” they asked. Jesus answered, “Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.”

18.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
18.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
18.bsb: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:

18.web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
18.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
18.bsb: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.

18.web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
18.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
18.bsb: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’

18.web: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
18.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
18.bsb: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,

18.web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
18.kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
18.bsb: yet because this widow keeps pestering me, I will give her justice. Then she will stop wearing me out with her perpetual requests.’”

18.web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
18.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
18.bsb: And the Lord said, “Listen to the words of the unjust judge.

18.web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
18.kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
18.bsb: Will not God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He continue to defer their help?

18.web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
18.kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
18.bsb: I tell you, He will promptly carry out justice on their behalf. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on earth?”

18.web: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
18.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
18.bsb: To some who trusted in their own righteousness and viewed others with contempt, He also told this parable:

18.web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
18.kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
18.bsb: “Two men went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

18.web: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
18.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are , extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
18.bsb: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like the other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.

18.web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
18.kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
18.bsb: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that I acquire.’

18.web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
18.kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
18.bsb: But the tax collector stood at a distance, unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’

18.web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
18.kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
18.bsb: I tell you, this man, rather than the Pharisee, went home justified. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”

18.web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
18.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them.
18.bsb: Now people were even bringing their babies to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them. And when the disciples saw this, they rebuked those who brought them.

18.web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
18.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him , and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
18.bsb: But Jesus called the children to Him and said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

18.web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
18.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
18.bsb: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

18.web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
18.kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
18.bsb: Then a certain ruler asked Him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

18.web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one—God.
18.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is , God.
18.bsb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.

18.web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
18.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
18.bsb: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.’”

18.web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
18.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
18.bsb: “All these I have kept from my youth,” he said.

18.web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.”
18.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
18.bsb: On hearing this, Jesus told him, “You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”

18.web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
18.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
18.bsb: But when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.

18.web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
18.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
18.bsb: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

18.web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
18.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
18.bsb: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”

18.web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
18.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
18.bsb: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”

18.web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
18.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
18.bsb: But Jesus said, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”

18.web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything, and followed you.”
18.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
18.bsb: “Look,” said Peter, “we have left all we had to follow You.”

18.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,
18.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,
18.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God

18.web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
18.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
18.bsb: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.”

18.web: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
18.kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
18.bsb: Then Jesus took the Twelve aside and said to them, “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything the prophets have written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.

18.web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
18.kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
18.bsb: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.

18.web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
18.kjv: And they shall scourge him , and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
18.bsb: They will flog Him and kill Him, and on the third day He will rise again.”

18.web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
18.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
18.bsb: But the disciples did not understand any of these things. The meaning was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend what He was saying.

18.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
18.kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
18.bsb: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.

18.web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
18.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
18.bsb: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.

18.web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
18.kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
18.bsb: “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by,” they told him.

18.web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
18.kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
18.bsb: So he called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

18.web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
18.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
18.bsb: Those who led the way admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

18.web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
18.kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
18.bsb: Jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to Him. When he had been brought near, Jesus asked him,

18.web: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
18.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
18.bsb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” “Lord,” he said, “let me see again.”

18.web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
18.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
18.bsb: “Receive your sight!” Jesus replied. “Your faith has healed you.”

18.web: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
18.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it , gave praise unto God.
18.bsb: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God. And all the people who saw this gave praise to God.

19.web: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
19.kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
19.bsb: Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

19.web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
19.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
19.bsb: And there was a man named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.

19.web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
19.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
19.bsb: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.

19.web: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.
19.kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way .
19.bsb: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him, since Jesus was about to pass that way.

19.web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
19.kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
19.bsb: When Jesus came to that place, He looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.”

19.web: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
19.kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
19.bsb: So Zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed Him joyfully.

19.web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
19.kjv: And when they saw it , they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
19.bsb: And all who saw this began to grumble, saying, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!”

19.web: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
19.kjv: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
19.bsb: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”

19.web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
19.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
19.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.

19.web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
19.kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
19.bsb: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”

19.web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
19.kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
19.bsb: While the people were listening to this, Jesus proceeded to tell them a parable, because He was near Jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of God would appear imminently.

19.web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
19.kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
19.bsb: So He said, “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.

19.web: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
19.kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
19.bsb: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Conduct business with this until I return,’ he said.

19.web: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
19.kjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
19.bsb: But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us.’

19.web: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
19.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
19.bsb: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.

19.web: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
19.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
19.bsb: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’

19.web: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
19.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
19.bsb: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

19.web: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
19.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
19.bsb: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’

19.web: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
19.kjv: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
19.bsb: And to this one he said, ‘You shall have authority over five cities.’

19.web: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
19.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
19.bsb: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.

19.web: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
19.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
19.bsb: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’

19.web: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down, and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
19.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
19.bsb: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?

19.web: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
19.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
19.bsb: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’

19.web: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him, and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
19.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
19.bsb: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’

19.web: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
19.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
19.bsb: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’

19.web: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
19.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
19.bsb: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.

19.web: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
19.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
19.bsb: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.’”

19.web: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
19.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
19.bsb: After Jesus had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

19.web: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
19.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
19.bsb: As He approached Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, He sent out two of His disciples,

19.web: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man had ever sat upon. Untie it, and bring it.
19.kjv: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither .
19.bsb: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.

19.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
19.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
19.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”

19.web: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
19.kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
19.bsb: So those who were sent went out and found it just as Jesus had told them.

19.web: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
19.kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
19.bsb: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”

19.web: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
19.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
19.bsb: “The Lord needs it,” they answered.

19.web: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.
19.kjv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
19.bsb: Then they led the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks over it, and put Jesus on it.

19.web: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
19.kjv: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
19.bsb: As He rode along, the people spread their cloaks on the road.

19.web: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
19.kjv: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
19.bsb: And as He approached the descent from the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of disciples began to praise God joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:

19.web: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
19.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
19.bsb: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”

19.web: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
19.kjv: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
