19.bsb: But some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!”

19.web: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
19.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
19.bsb: “I tell you,” He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.”

19.web: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
19.kjv: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
19.bsb: As Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city, He wept over it

19.web: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
19.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
19.bsb: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.

19.web: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
19.kjv: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
19.bsb: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.

19.web: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
19.kjv: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
19.bsb: They will level you to the ground—you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God.”

19.web: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
19.kjv: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
19.bsb: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were selling there.

19.web: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
19.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
19.bsb: He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”

19.web: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
19.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
19.bsb: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him.

19.web: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
19.kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
19.bsb: Yet they could not find a way to do so, because all the people hung on His words.

20.web: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
20.kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
20.bsb: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the gospel, the chief priests and scribes, together with the elders, came up to Him.

20.web: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
20.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
20.bsb: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”

20.web: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
20.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
20.bsb: “I will also ask you a question,” Jesus replied. “Tell Me:

20.web: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
20.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
20.bsb: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?”

20.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
20.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
20.bsb: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’

20.web: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
20.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
20.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.”

20.web: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
20.kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was .
20.bsb: So they answered that they did not know where it was from.

20.web: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
20.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
20.bsb: And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”

20.web: He began to tell the people this parable. “A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
20.kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
20.bsb: Then He proceeded to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenants, and went away for a long time.

20.web: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.
20.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
20.bsb: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.

20.web: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
20.kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
20.bsb: So he sent another servant, but they beat him and treated him shamefully, sending him away empty-handed.

20.web: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.
20.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
20.bsb: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.

20.web: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
20.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
20.bsb: ‘What shall I do?’ asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’

20.web: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
20.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
20.bsb: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

20.web: They threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
20.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
20.bsb: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

20.web: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard it, they said, “May it never be!”
20.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it , they said, God forbid.
20.bsb: He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.” And when the people heard this, they said, “May such a thing never happen!”

20.web: But he looked at them, and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?’
20.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
20.bsb: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?

20.web: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
20.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
20.bsb: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”

20.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
20.kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
20.bsb: When the scribes and chief priests realized that Jesus had spoken this parable against them, they sought to arrest Him that very hour. But they were afraid of the people.

20.web: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
20.kjv: And they watched him , and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
20.bsb: So they watched Him closely and sent spies who pretended to be sincere. They were hoping to catch Him in His words in order to hand Him over to the rule and authority of the governor.

20.web: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
20.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any , but teachest the way of God truly:
20.bsb: “Teacher,” they inquired, “we know that You speak and teach correctly. You show no partiality, but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

20.web: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
20.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?
20.bsb: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

20.web: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
20.kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
20.bsb: But Jesus saw through their duplicity and said to them,

20.web: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
20.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cæsar’s.
20.bsb: “Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.

20.web: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
20.kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.
20.bsb: So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

20.web: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.
20.kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
20.bsb: And they were unable to trap Him in His words before the people; and amazed at His answer, they fell silent.

20.web: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
20.kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
20.bsb: Then some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to question Him.

20.web: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.
20.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
20.bsb: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.

20.web: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
20.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
20.bsb: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife, but died childless.

20.web: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
20.kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
20.bsb: Then the second

20.web: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
20.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
20.bsb: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.

20.web: Afterward the woman also died.
20.kjv: Last of all the woman died also.
20.bsb: And last of all, the woman died.

20.web: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
20.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
20.bsb: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”

20.web: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.
20.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
20.bsb: Jesus answered, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.

20.web: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.
20.kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
20.bsb: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.

20.web: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
20.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
20.bsb: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.

20.web: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
20.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
20.bsb: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

20.web: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
20.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
20.bsb: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”

20.web: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
20.kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
20.bsb: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, You have spoken well!”

20.web: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
20.kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
20.bsb: And they did not dare to question Him any further.

20.web: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
20.kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David’s son?
20.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “How can it be said that the Christ is the Son of David?

20.web: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
20.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
20.bsb: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand

20.web: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
20.kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
20.bsb: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’

20.web: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
20.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
20.bsb: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”

20.web: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
20.kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
20.bsb: In the hearing of all the people, Jesus said to His disciples,

20.web: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
20.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
20.bsb: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.

20.web: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.”
20.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
20.bsb: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”

21.web: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
21.kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
21.bsb: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,

21.web: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
21.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
21.bsb: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.

21.web: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
21.kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
21.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.

21.web: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
21.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
21.bsb: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”

21.web: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
21.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
21.bsb: As some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, Jesus said,

21.web: “As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
21.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
21.bsb: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

21.web: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
21.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
21.bsb: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”

21.web: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
21.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
21.bsb: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.

21.web: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
21.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
21.bsb: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.”

21.web: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
21.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
21.bsb: Then He told them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

21.web: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
21.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
21.bsb: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.

21.web: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
21.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.
21.bsb: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.

21.web: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
21.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
21.bsb: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.

21.web: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
21.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
21.bsb: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.

21.web: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
21.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
21.bsb: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.

21.web: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
21.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
21.bsb: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.

21.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
21.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
21.bsb: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.

21.web: And not a hair of your head will perish.
21.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
21.bsb: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.

21.web: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
21.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.
21.bsb: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.

21.web: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
21.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
21.bsb: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.

21.web: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
21.kjv: Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
21.bsb: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.

21.web: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
21.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
21.bsb: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.

21.web: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.
21.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
21.bsb: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.

21.web: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
21.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
21.bsb: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

21.web: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
21.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
21.bsb: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.

21.web: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
21.kjv: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
21.bsb: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

21.web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
21.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
21.bsb: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

21.web: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
21.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
21.bsb: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

21.web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree, and all the trees.
21.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
21.bsb: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.

21.web: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
21.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
21.bsb: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

21.web: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.
21.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
21.bsb: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.

21.web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
21.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
21.bsb: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.

21.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
21.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
21.bsb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

21.web: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
21.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
21.bsb: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.

21.web: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
21.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
21.bsb: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.

21.web: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
21.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
21.bsb: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”

21.web: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
21.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
21.bsb: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.

21.web: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
21.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
21.bsb: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.

22.web: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.
22.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
22.bsb: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

22.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
22.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
22.bsb: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people.

22.web: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.
22.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
22.bsb: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.

22.web: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
22.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
22.bsb: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.

22.web: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
22.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
22.bsb: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

22.web: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
22.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
22.bsb: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.

22.web: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
22.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
22.bsb: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.

22.web: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
22.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
22.bsb: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.”

22.web: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
22.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
22.bsb: “Where do You want us to prepare it?” they asked.

22.web: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
22.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
22.bsb: He answered, “When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,

22.web: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
22.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
22.bsb: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’

22.web: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
22.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
22.bsb: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”

22.web: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
22.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
22.bsb: So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover.

22.web: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
22.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
22.bsb: When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles.

22.web: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
22.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
22.bsb: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.

22.web: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”
22.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
22.bsb: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”

22.web: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this, and share it among yourselves,
22.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
22.bsb: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.

22.web: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”
22.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
22.bsb: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”

22.web: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
22.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it , and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
22.bsb: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

22.web: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
22.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
22.bsb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.

22.web: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
22.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
22.bsb: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.

22.web: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
22.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
22.bsb: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”

22.web: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
22.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
22.bsb: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.

22.web: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
22.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
22.bsb: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them would be considered the greatest.

22.web: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
22.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
22.bsb: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.

22.web: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
22.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
22.bsb: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.

22.web: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
22.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
22.bsb: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.

22.web: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
22.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
22.bsb: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.

22.web: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
22.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
22.bsb: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,

22.web: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
22.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
22.bsb: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

22.web: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
22.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
22.bsb: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.

22.web: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
22.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
22.bsb: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”

22.web: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
22.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
22.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”

22.web: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
22.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
22.bsb: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”

22.web: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
22.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
22.bsb: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?” “Nothing,” they answered.

22.web: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
22.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it , and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
22.bsb: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.

22.web: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me has an end.”
22.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
22.bsb: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”

22.web: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
22.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
22.bsb: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.

22.web: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
22.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
22.bsb: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.

22.web: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
22.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
22.bsb: When He came to the place, He told them, “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”

22.web: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
22.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
22.bsb: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,

22.web: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
22.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
22.bsb: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”

22.web: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
22.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
22.bsb: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.

22.web: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
22.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
22.bsb: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.

22.web: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,
22.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
22.bsb: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

22.web: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
22.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
22.bsb: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”

22.web: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.
22.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
22.bsb: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.

22.web: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
22.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
22.bsb: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”

22.web: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”
22.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
22.bsb: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”

22.web: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
22.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
22.bsb: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

22.web: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear, and healed him.
22.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
22.bsb: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.

22.web: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
22.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
22.bsb: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?

22.web: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
22.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
22.bsb: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”

22.web: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
22.kjv: Then took they him, and led him , and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.
22.bsb: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.

22.web: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
22.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
22.bsb: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.

22.web: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
22.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
22.bsb: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. “This man also was with Him,” she said.

22.web: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
22.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
22.bsb: But Peter denied it. “Woman, I do not know Him,” he said.

22.web: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
22.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
22.bsb: A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”

22.web: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”
22.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.
22.bsb: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”

22.web: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
22.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
22.bsb: “Man, I do not know what you are talking about,” Peter replied. While he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.

22.web: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”
22.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
22.bsb: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”

22.web: He went out, and wept bitterly.
22.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
22.bsb: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

22.web: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
22.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him .
22.bsb: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.

22.web: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
22.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
22.bsb: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”

22.web: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
22.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
22.bsb: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.

22.web: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
22.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
22.bsb: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,

22.web: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
22.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
22.bsb: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.

22.web: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
22.kjv: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
22.bsb: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.

22.web: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
22.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
22.bsb: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

22.web: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
22.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
22.bsb: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”

22.web: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
22.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
22.bsb: “Why do we need any more testimony?” they declared. “We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.”

23.web: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
23.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
23.bsb: Then the whole council rose and led Jesus away to Pilate.

23.web: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
23.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
23.bsb: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”

23.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
23.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it .
23.bsb: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.

23.web: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
23.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
23.bsb: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

23.web: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
23.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
23.bsb: But they kept insisting, “He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.”

23.web: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
23.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.
23.bsb: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

23.web: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
23.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
23.bsb: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.

23.web: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
23.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season , because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
23.bsb: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.

23.web: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
23.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
23.bsb: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.

23.web: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
23.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
23.bsb: Meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing Him.

23.web: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
23.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
23.bsb: And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.

23.web: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
23.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
23.bsb: That day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies.

23.web: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
23.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
23.bsb: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

23.web: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
23.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
23.bsb: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.

23.web: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
23.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
23.bsb: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.

23.web: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
23.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him .
23.bsb: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.”

23.web: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
23.kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

23.web: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
23.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas:
23.bsb: But they all cried out in unison: “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”

23.web: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
23.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
23.bsb: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)

23.web: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
23.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
23.bsb: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,

23.web: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
23.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him , crucify him.
23.bsb: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”

23.web: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
23.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
23.bsb: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”

23.web: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
23.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
23.bsb: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor prevailed.

23.web: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
23.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
23.bsb: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.

23.web: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
23.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
23.bsb: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and handed Jesus over to their will.

23.web: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.
23.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
23.bsb: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.

23.web: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
23.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
23.bsb: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.

23.web: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
23.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
23.bsb: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

23.web: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
23.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
23.bsb: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’

23.web: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
23.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
23.bsb: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’

23.web: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
23.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
23.bsb: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”

23.web: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
23.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
23.bsb: Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.

23.web: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
23.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
23.bsb: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.

23.web: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
23.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
23.bsb: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.

23.web: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
23.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him , saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
23.bsb: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”

23.web: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
23.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
23.bsb: The soldiers also mocked Him and came up to offer Him sour wine.

23.web: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
23.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
23.bsb: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”

23.web: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
23.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
23.bsb: Above Him was posted an inscription: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

23.web: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
23.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
23.bsb: One of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on Him. “Are You not the Christ?” he said. “Save Yourself and us!”

23.web: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
23.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
23.bsb: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?

23.web: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
23.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
23.bsb: We are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”

23.web: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
23.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
23.bsb: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”

23.web: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
23.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
23.bsb: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”

23.web: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
23.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
23.bsb: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.

23.web: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
23.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
23.bsb: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.

23.web: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
23.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
23.bsb: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.

23.web: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
23.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
23.bsb: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man.”

23.web: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.
23.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
23.bsb: And when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.

23.web: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
23.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
23.bsb: But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things.

23.web: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
23.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
23.bsb: Now there was a Council member named Joseph, a good and righteous man,

23.web: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom:
23.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
23.bsb: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea, and was waiting for the kingdom of God.

23.web: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
23.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
23.bsb: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.

23.web: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
23.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
23.bsb: Then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.

23.web: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
23.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
23.bsb: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.

23.web: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.
23.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
23.bsb: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.

23.web: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
23.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
23.bsb: Then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes. And they rested on the Sabbath, according to the commandment.

24.web: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
24.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
24.bsb: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.

24.web: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
24.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
24.bsb: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,

24.web: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
24.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
24.bsb: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

24.web: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
24.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
24.bsb: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.

24.web: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
24.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
24.bsb: As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?

24.web: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
24.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
24.bsb: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:

24.web: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
24.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
24.bsb: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.’”

24.web: They remembered his words,
24.kjv: And they remembered his words,
24.bsb: Then they remembered His words.

24.web: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
24.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
24.bsb: And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.

24.web: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
24.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
24.bsb: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.

24.web: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
24.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
24.bsb: But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.

24.web: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
24.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
24.bsb: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

24.web: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
24.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
24.bsb: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

24.web: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
24.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
24.bsb: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

24.web: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
24.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
24.bsb: And as they talked and deliberated, Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.

24.web: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
24.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
24.bsb: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.

24.web: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
24.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
24.bsb: He asked them, “What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?” They stood still, with sadness on their faces.

24.web: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
24.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
24.bsb: One of them, named Cleopas, asked Him, “Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?”

24.web: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
